svg.title: Two-floor PCB placement — Ing. Alex M. Rivera
svg.desc: Top views of the two unrouted boards. Base cable relief retained, upper relief filled. Nominal module projections fit the 44 mm cylinder; height and cable bend remain unverified.

g.text: Same orientation and scale · top views · dashed circle: 44 mm cylinder clearance
Original base outline · J2 cable solder pads
Cable relief filled · upright ADC on right wing
Blue: nominal XIAO body · amber: provisional upright ADS1115 component projection
No tracks / copper zones · USB J2 → J4 → J5 → short USB-C male plug → XIAO socket
